name: genetic toggle, unequal promoters

slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of alpha
slots.A: alpha=4, n=2, gamma=1.25; control alpha in (0.5, 6.0); noise D=0.05

events.kind: saddle-node (fold): a state appears or vanishes; written by a pulse past the threshold

required: A quadratic term makes the write one-sided (a threshold): the material must supply the mirror term -a2 s^2, from a symmetric partner of the critical mode or a second parameter tuned to the cusp.
Changing the control also pushes the critical mode, so a sweep writes a fixed state: the protocol must add the opposite field, or the material must be symmetric under reversal of the mode.

normal_form_along_sweep.kind: supercritical pitchfork: symmetric write; a small bias chooses the state

required: No obstruction: along the critical direction the target realizes the pitchfork generator eps s - |a3| s^3 + h, with eps proportional to the distance of the control from its critical value.

events.kind: saddle-node (fold): a state appears or vanishes; written by a pulse past the threshold

required: A quadratic term makes the write one-sided (a threshold): the material must supply the mirror term -a2 s^2, from a symmetric partner of the critical mode or a second parameter tuned to the cusp.
Changing the control also pushes the critical mode, so a sweep writes a fixed state: the protocol must add the opposite field, or the material must be symmetric under reversal of the mode.

threshold_source: field at which the write-field continuation loses the stored state

verdict.writes: saddle-node (fold) at alpha = 3.27; a uniform field removes the stable state at h = 0.446
verdict.constructs: fold: one-sided write; a symmetric write is recovered at the cusp gamma = 1, alpha = 2 (supercritical pitchfork along the sweep)
verdict.lock: field 0.4 x threshold, fixed control: accuracy 0.00, not rewritten; field 1.5 x threshold, fixed control: accuracy 0.73, retention/rewriting time ratio > 21.5; field 0.4 x threshold, control swept through the write point: accuracy 0.30, retention/rewriting time ratio > 129
